name: rn-media

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/player run build && npm --prefix packages/audio-session run build && npm --prefix packages/media-session run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/player run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/audio-session run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/media-session run typecheck

//typescript: NOT the version this repo is written in — every package and the example app pin `typescript` themselves (^7.0.2) and their own `tsc` resolves that. This root pin exists for the ESLint stack: typescript-eslint 8 peers `typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0`, has no TypeScript 7 support, and npm hoists its packages (`@typescript-eslint/*`, `ts-api-utils`) to the workspace root — where `require('typescript')` resolves HERE. With TypeScript 7 in this slot `ts-api-utils` throws on load (`ts.TypeFlags` is undefined) and `eslint .` cannot run at all. `~6.0.3` is the newest release inside typescript-eslint's peer range. Delete this pin (and the whole workaround) once typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7.
